results.title: Denmark ratifies Greenland security deal after months of pressure by Trump
results.content: Denmark's parliament on Thursday ratified a security deal involving Greenland and the United States. The vote comes months after the US, Denmark and Greenland ​signed the ‌agreement to end a standoff with the Trump administration over the Arctic island's future.

Infantino to face France's Diallo and Japan's Tashima in FIFA presidential election
results.content: FIFA confirmed on Thursday that France's Philippe Diallo and Japan's Kozo Tashima will run against incumbent Gianni Infantino in next year's presidential election. Infantino has faced criticism since July over his aborted plan to sell stakes in World Cup profits to private investors.

results.title: France: Seven masculinists stand trial in Paris
results.content: Seven masculinists are facing trial in Paris on November 18 and 19. Aged between 26 and 54, the defendants are accused of sharing misogynistic, racist and anti-Semitic comments on a Telegram channel.

results.title: Xi Jinping, Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin begin unprecedented summit in China
results.content: Xi Jinping, Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin opened their first trilateral talks in Shenzhen on the sidelines of the APEC forum, a meeting analysts expect to offer more symbolism than breakthroughs and that critics fear could carve the world into spheres of influence. Ukraine, the Iran war, nuclear disarmament and AI are all expected to come up, while Trump and Xi also held one-on-one talks on trade and technology.

results.title: South Korea tightens security for national exam over AI cheating scandal
results.content: More than 550,000 candidates sat South Korea’s Suneung university entrance exam under extraordinary security, after an AI cheating scandal in which a top scorer on a national tax accountant exam admitted using a hidden mini camera to send questions to an AI system. Authorities inspected students’ glasses, deployed thousands of extra supervisors and ordered stickers over every button on candidates’ clothing. A nationwide disaster alert was also sent to make even muted phones buzz, exposing any devices smuggled into exam rooms.

results.title: Nuclear arms at the center of the Shenzhen trilateral meeting
results.content: Nuclear weapons are at the top of Donald Trump’s agenda at the trilateral summit in Beijing. The US president wants the United States, Russia and China to reduce their nuclear stockpiles, and FRANCE 24’s Philip Turle expects him to push hard for a three-way agreement on the issue. Iran is also a key part of the discussion. The three leaders share an interest in preventing the Iranian regime from acquiring nuclear weapons. Regional conflicts and oil prices are also se to be central issues.

Skyscraper in Riyadh damaged as Saudi Arabia reports surge in new Houthi attacks
results.content: A skyscraper in Saudi Arabia's capital Riyadh was damaged on Thursday after the Gulf country reported new attacks by Yemen's Houthis. Witnesses said the city's Public Investment Fund Tower, which showcases Saudi Arabia's economic ambitions, was "damaged across several floors, with windows blown out".

results.title: Gaza: Israel launched new offensive on Nuseirat
results.content: Israeli tanks have moved east of the Nuseirat refugee camp in central Gaza, with witnesses reporting heavy shelling, gunfire and airstrikes as the Israeli military says it has launched an operation in a Hamas-controlled area. Strikes killed at least three people on Wednesday, and displaced families are fleeing again, saying there is no real ceasefire. Israel and Hamas accuse each other of breaking the truce in force since October 2025, while Gadi Eisenkot tries to form a government after inconclusive elections.

results.title: APEC summit: Trump seeks nuclear arms cuts, but few concrete results expected
results.content: Donald Trump has arrived at the APEC summit for talks with Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin, but expectations for concrete results are low. Nothing substantial is likely to come out of the meeting, as was the case in his previous encounters with the two leaders, says Fraser Jackson, FRANCE 24’s correspondent in Washington. The main issue on the table is nuclear disarmament, with Trump seeking to get the United States and China to reduce their stockpiles. The wars in Iran and Ukraine are also expected to feature in the discussions.

results.title: APEC summit: AI and tech competition between US and China
results.content: Chinese President Xi Jinping is welcoming US President Donald Trump and Russia’s Vladimir Putin on Thursday for the first-ever three-way summit between the leaders. Beyond the wars in Ukraine and Iran, artificial intelligence and emerging technologies are expected to feature in the talks between Washington and Beijing, as the two powers compete for the lead in AI, advanced chips and other strategic technologies.

results.title: FIFA rankings: France finish the year on the podium, Morocco break into top five
results.content: FIFA has unveiled its final world ranking of 2026. France remain third in the world, behind Spain and Argentina. Les Bleus finish in the top three for the ninth consecutive year. Morocco climb two places to fifth, equalling the best-ever ranking by an African nation, previously achieved by Nigeria in 1994. Brazil drop to seventh place, while Senegal remain 18th and Ivory Coast sit 28th.

results.title: Middle East crisis poses 'largest threat' to energy security in history, warns IEA
results.content: The International Energy Agency said on Thursday that the Middle East crisis triggered by US and Israeli strikes on Iran in February posed the “largest threat” to energy security in history. It warned that consumers were bearing more of the costs as Iran’s blockade of the Strait of Hormuz disrupted oil shipments.

results.title: Ukraine's allies to meet in Berlin to rally support for Kyiv after Trump-Putin-Xi talks
results.content: Ukraine's allies will meet in Berlin on Thursday, just hours after US President Donald Trump, Russia's Vladimir Putin and China's Xi Jinping participate in a historic summit in Shenzhen. The "Coalition of the Willing" summit comes as Europe backs Kyiv in the war against Russia and seeks a seat at the table of any future peace talks.

results.title: COP31: Vanuatu calls for UN climate summit reform, warns of backsliding
results.content: Vanuatu's Environment Minister Ralph Regenvanu has called for changes to the UN climate summit process, accusing a small group of countries of blocking progress and warning that COP31 risks reversing previous commitments.

results.title: Live: Historic trilateral Xi-Putin-Trump summit ends in Shenzhen, China
results.content: A historic trilateral summit between US President Donald Trump, China's Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin in Shenzhen, China has concluded. Beijing said the meeting was aimed at "safeguarding world peace", but it has raised fears of a carve-up of the globe into "spheres of influence". Follow our liveblog for the latest developments.

results.title: 24-month matured Comté crowned world’s best cheese
results.content: With its nutty flavour and smooth, supple texture, it was aged for two years in a former military fortress in eastern France. Comté, an unpasteurised cow’s milk cheese from the Jura Mountains, has beaten more than five thousand challengers to the top prize at the prestigious annual 'World Cheese Awards'. FRANCE 24's Daniel Whittington has the story.

results.title: Inside Limoges City Hall devastated by arson attack
results.content: Work is underway to restore the city hall of Limoges, in central France, which was devastated by an arson attack during riots on October 17. More than €1.7 million has been raised through an online fundraising campaign in the wake of the disaster. Also on the show, the highly anticipated Grand Theft Auto VI has finally been released, with gamers in Oceania among the first to get a taste of the latest instalment in the video game franchise.

results.title: Crimea bridge strike: Fact-checking fake videos of damage after Ukraine's attack
results.content: Ukraine struck the Kerch Bridge linking Russia to occupied Crimea, but not all the dramatic footage circulating online is real. Multiple AI-generated videos falsely show the bridge collapsed with extensive damage. Some even used branding resembling a Ukrainian news agency to appear credible. While the bridge was indeed struck and damaged, the viral videos were fabricated using AI, as Vedika Bahl explains.

results.title: Bassirou Diomaye Faye excluded from Senegal's ruling party
results.content: In tonight's edition, the political divorce between Senegal's president and the powerful former prime minister and mentor is official. Also, all of Nigeria's states have shown willingness for a push to create their own police forces. And in parts of the continent, conflict and a drop in funding have placed huge pressures on children's learning.

results.title: Reconstruction begins at Limoges City Hall after devastating fire
results.content: It's been a month since the nationwide protests that degenerated in violence across France. The dramatic pictures of the historic City Hall in the French city of Limoges set on fire made headlines worldwide. To the relief of many, the reconstruction work on the building has now begun. Since the fire, donations have poured in and already about 80 percent of the necessary funding has been secured. FRANCE 24's Caitlin Brown reports.

results.title: US Democrats nominate Jeffries to be first Black House speaker
results.content: Hakeem Jeffries is on the cusp of becoming the first Black speaker of the US House of Representatives after Democrats elected him their leader Wednesday following a sweeping midterm election triumph. Jeffries faced no declared challenger, although opposition from some newly elected progressives had exposed divisions over how Democrats should wield their newfound power. FRANCE 24's Fraser Jackson reports from Washington.
